title: Fix creativeProvider ESM/CJS regression — requires() ESM logger.js
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) finding P0-001 (council escalation)

The Wave A fix for MSA-ADAPT-001 renamed `creativeProvider.js` to `creativeProvider.cjs` to solve the CommonJS-in-ESM problem. However, `creativeProvider.cjs` still imports `logger.js` via `require('./logger')` — and `logger.js` is an ESM module (uses `export` syntax, and the project has `"type": "module"` in `package.json`). This means `require('./logger')` fails with `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM`, and the creative provisioning path crashes at runtime.

**Impact:** Creative-mode block placement is broken. The bot cannot build in creative mode.

**Recommendation:** Either:
(a) Convert `logger.js` to CommonJS as well (rename to `.cjs`), or
(b) Convert `creativeProvider.cjs` to ESM syntax (`import`/`export default`), or
(c) Inline the logging dependency in `creativeProvider.cjs` to avoid the cross-format import.
